## The command Check test
The orchestrator ran `npm test` after your work and it FAILED:

```
not ok 2 - widgets total
```

Make it pass. Do not change a test your Visit may not change: if such a test is wrong, claim blocked with reason
bad-test and say what is wrong with it. Put anything the reviewer should know in notes.
If you cannot make it pass, claim blocked and say why in "diagnosis".
